nodes.name: delivery-map.tsx
nodes.summary: Leaflet-based delivery map component letting the customer pick a delivery pin, with geolocation control, recentering and an address search box.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses react-leaflet hooks (useMap) inside child components to imperatively drive the map.

nodes.name: Recenter
nodes.summary: Effect-only child that flies the Leaflet map to a new center when coordinates change.

nodes.name: LocateControl
nodes.summary: Map control button that requests the browser's geolocation and pans to the user's position.

nodes.name: MapSearch
nodes.summary: Address search overlay that geocodes free-text queries and moves the pin to a chosen result.

nodes.name: DeliveryMap
nodes.summary: Exported map wrapper composing the tile layer, draggable pin, locate control and search into one delivery location picker.

nodes.name: item-customizer.tsx
nodes.summary: Bottom drawer for configuring a menu item before adding it to the cart: size selection, addon groups with quantities, per-line notes and quantity, with price computed live.

nodes.name: ItemCustomizer
nodes.summary: Main customizer drawer managing size, addon selections, quantity and notes state, validating group min/max rules and emitting a configured cart line.

nodes.name: AddonGroupSection
nodes.summary: Renders one addon group with its options honoring single/multi select and min/max constraints.

nodes.name: AddonQtyRow
nodes.summary: Row for a quantity-based addon with increment/decrement controls bounded by FIELD_LIMITS.addonQty.

nodes.name: OptionRow
nodes.summary: Selectable option row showing name, price delta and selected state.

nodes.name: Section
nodes.summary: Labeled section wrapper with optional required/limit hint used inside the customizer.

nodes.name: Chip
nodes.summary: Small toggle chip used for size selection.

nodes.name: location-step.tsx
nodes.summary: Delivery location step: lets the guest choose a saved location or drop a pin on the DeliveryMap, fills address fields, and shows the live delivery-fee quote status.

nodes.name: LocationStep
nodes.summary: Step component orchestrating saved-location selection, map pin placement, address form fields and quote requests before continuing to the menu.

nodes.name: SavedLocationRow
nodes.summary: Selectable row for a previously saved guest location.

nodes.name: distanceText
nodes.summary: Formats a distance in meters into a localized km/m label.

nodes.name: QuoteStatus
nodes.summary: Displays the delivery quote state: loading, out-of-range error, or fee and ETA.

nodes.name: Banner
nodes.summary: Inline informational or warning banner used within the step.

nodes.name: menu-step.tsx
nodes.summary: Menu browsing step with category tabs, search, item cards and skeleton loading; opens the ItemCustomizer to add items to the cart.

nodes.name: MenuStep
nodes.summary: Renders the grouped menu with category navigation and search, tracks the item being customized and forwards cart additions.

nodes.name: MenuCard
nodes.summary: Card for a single menu item showing image, translated name, description and starting price.

nodes.name: Empty
nodes.summary: Empty state shown when search yields no items.

nodes.name: buildGroups
nodes.summary: Groups and filters menu items by category and search query into ordered sections.

nodes.name: order-history-drawer.tsx
nodes.summary: Side sheet listing a guest's previous orders with status, items and totals, offering a reorder action.

nodes.name: OrderHistoryDrawer
nodes.summary: Sheet wrapper rendering the list of past orders or an empty message.

nodes.name: OrderCard
nodes.summary: Card summarizing one past order: date, status badge, item lines, total and reorder button.

nodes.name: otp-dialog.tsx
nodes.summary: Dialog for entering the SMS one-time code sent to the guest's phone, with auto-advance digit inputs, resend countdown and error display.

nodes.name: OtpDialog
nodes.summary: Manages the OTP digit inputs, resend timer and verification submission.

nodes.name: phone-step.tsx
nodes.summary: Phone number step: validates and normalizes an Egyptian mobile number, remembers returning guests via device token and triggers OTP verification.

nodes.name: PhoneStep
nodes.summary: Phone entry form with normalization, validation feedback, returning-guest lookup and continue handling.

nodes.name: step-shell.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared page chrome for each ordering step: header with back button, brand/branch name, language and theme toggles, cart button and progress indicator.

nodes.name: HeaderIcon
nodes.summary: Round header icon button used for back, language, theme and cart actions.

nodes.name: StepShell
nodes.summary: Layout wrapper rendering the step header, progress dots and scrollable content area.

nodes.name: limits.ts
nodes.summary: FIELD_LIMITS constants mirroring the backend's public-ordering field caps (name, address, notes, cart size, quantities) for client-side guarding.

nodes.name: public-ordering-page.tsx
nodes.summary: Top-level customer ordering page: drives the branch → channel → phone → location → menu → checkout → done step machine, holds cart and guest state, wires all step components and submits the order.
nodes.languageNotes: A single very large component (≈840 lines) coordinating many step sub-components and localStorage-persisted state.

nodes.name: PublicOrderingPage
nodes.summary: Main page component owning step navigation, cart, guest profile, delivery quote and order submission, rendering the current step inside StepShell.

nodes.name: channelOpenNow
nodes.summary: Checks whether a delivery channel is currently open based on its schedule.

nodes.name: stepHeaders
nodes.summary: Builds the translated title/subtitle for each step of the flow.

nodes.name: scan-to-order.tsx
nodes.summary: Landing/empty state of the order app root prompting the customer to scan a table QR code; applies the storefront theme and renders inside StorefrontShell.

nodes.name: ScanToOrder
nodes.summary: Animated bilingual prompt to scan a QR code, scoped to the light storefront theme.
